---
title: "Is climate change a priority for US presidents?"
author: "Henrique Sposito, James Hollway, and Jael Tan"
date: '2026'
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(poldis)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(tidyr)
library(ggthemes)
library(messydates)
```

```{r}
# load data
load("~/GitHub/poldis/inst/US_presidential_speeches_1993_2025.rda")
US_speeches <- US_speeches |>
  filter(grepl("climate change|global warming",
               text, ignore.case = TRUE)) |>
  mutate(doc_id = paste0("text", row_number()))
# get priorities
priorities <- select_priorities(US_speeches$text)
# assign urgency scores
urgency <- get_urgency(priorities, summarise = "mean")
# filter for climate change, health, migration, and employment priorities
clim_urgency <- filter(urgency,
                       grepl("climate change|global warming",
                             priorities, ignore.case = TRUE) &
                        Commitment > 0) |> # Remove non-priorities
  left_join(US_speeches, by = "doc_id") |>
  mutate(cat = "CC")
hth_urgency <- filter(urgency, grepl("health|pandemic|infection", 
                                     priorities, ignore.case = TRUE) &
                        Commitment > 0) |> # Remove non-priorities
  left_join(US_speeches, by = "doc_id") |>
  mutate(cat = "Health")
mig_urgency <- filter(urgency, grepl("migration|migrant",
  priorities, ignore.case = TRUE) & Commitment > 0) |> # Remove non-priorities
  left_join(US_speeches, by = "doc_id") |>
  mutate(cat = "Migration")
emp_urgency <- filter(urgency, grepl("employment|job|wage",
  priorities, ignore.case = TRUE) & Commitment > 0) |> # Remove non-priorities
  left_join(US_speeches, by = "doc_id") |>
  mutate(cat = "Employment")
# plot CC by speaker
clim_urgency |>
  group_by(date, speaker) |>
  summarise(max_urgency = max(Urgency, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = max_urgency)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = speaker), alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_smooth(aes(color = speaker), alpha = 0.25,
              method = "glm", se = TRUE, size = 2) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "2 years", date_labels = "%Y") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0,0.5,1,2,10)) + 
  theme_clean(base_size = 12, base_family = "times") +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Max Urgency Scores", color = "") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", 
        plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
# plot comparison of priorities
rbind(clim_urgency, emp_urgency, hth_urgency, mig_urgency) |>
  group_by(date, cat) |>
  summarise(max_urgency = max(Urgency, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = max_urgency)) +
  geom_smooth(aes(color = cat), alpha = 0.6, 
              method = "loess", se = FALSE) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "2 years", date_labels = "%Y") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0,0.5,1,2,10)) + 
  theme_clean(base_size = 12, base_family = "times") +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Max Urgency Scores", color = "") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", 
        plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
```
